item.tib: rtsa gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i rgyud las rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg 'dod 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba
item.coloph: ces pas 'di nyid snying grogs las 'phro mthun pa'i shes rab phun tshogs nas snga nas bskur (bskul) ba dang*/ phyis su grwa btsun g.yung drung phun tshogs nas dar dkar gsang gos dri med yug ring gis sna drangs nas rten 'brel legs pa'i brda' sbyar nas bskur (bskul) ba la brten nas ldong rigs kyi btsun tshul 7'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin nam mkha' sgron gsal 'bral med mngon par rol pa'i tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am/ g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa/ dbyings kyi gsang mtshan du mas brgyan pa bdag la rigs brgya'i bdag nyid stong rgyung mthu chen dngos su zhal mthong zhing brgyud pa bzhin du/ rgyal khams kyi khol po ba ste (gte) rgan g.yung drung rgyal mtshan du 'bod pa bdag gis shar grol smin gling du bsgyur zhing spel ba'o/ dge des zad med gter chen thob pa'i rgyu gyur cig/
